title: A protocol for exosome detection via the ultrafast-isolation system (EXODUS)
protocol: Collect a urine sample in a 15 mL tube (10 mL).
Centrifuge the collected urine sample at 2,000 x g, 4 °C for 10 min and transfer the supernatants to a new tube.
Filter the supernatant with a 0.22 µm syringe filter and collect filtration in a 15 mL tube.
Start the EXODUS system and load the prepared sample tube in the sample holder.
Set the isolation parameters: Negative pressure -30 kPa, Conversion time 10 s, Sample wash times 2.
Press the button “Out” to load the EXODUS device.
Press the button “Start Analyzing” to start exosome isolation. The EXODUS device will come out from the machine automatically after sample analysis.
Use a pipette to collect the exosome solution from the EXODUS device and reconstitute to 300 µL in a 1.5 mL centrifugation tube with 1X PBS.
Seed 1 x 10^6 293t cells per T-25 flask in 8 mL DMEM with 10% FBS.
After 24h, remove the medium and wash with PBS and then change to FBS-free DMEM medium.
After another 24h, collect the cell culture supernatant (15 mL).
Centrifuge at 1,000 x g, 4 °C for 10 min and transfer the supernatants to a new tube (14 mL).
Filter the supernatant with a 0.22 µm syringe filter and collect filtration in a 15 mL tube.
Filter supernatant with a 0.22 µm syringe filter.
Collect filtration in a 15 mL tube.
Start the EXODUS system.
Load the prepared sample tube in the sample holder.
Set isolation parameters: Negative pressure -20 kPa, Conversion time 10 s, Sample wash times 2.
Press the button “Out” to load the EXODUS device.
Press the button “Start Analyzing” to start exosome isolation.
Collect the exosome solution from the EXODUS device after analysis.
Reconstitute the collected exosome solution to 300 µL in a 1.5 mL centrifugation tube with 1X PBS.
Collect 1 mL of human saliva with Salivette®.
Centrifuge at 2,000 x g, 4 °C for 10 min.
Transfer the supernatants to a new tube.
Filter supernatant with a 0.22 µm syringe filter.
Make a 5x dilution of filtered supernatant with PBS in a 15 mL tube.
Start the EXODUS system.
Load the prepared sample tube in the sample holder.
Set isolation parameters: Negative pressure -30 kPa, Conversion time 10 s, Sample wash times 2.
Press the button “Out” to load the EXODUS device.
Press the button “Start Analyzing” to start exosome isolation.
Take 20 mL plasma sample and dilute to a final volume of 1 mL with PBS in a 15 mL tube.
Filter the diluted plasma sample with a 0.22 µm syringe filter and collect filtration in a 15 mL tube.
Start the EXODUS system and load the prepared sample tube into the sample holder.
Set isolation parameters: Negative pressure at -30 kPa, conversion time of 30 seconds, and two sample wash times.
Press the button “Out” to initiate loading of the EXODUS device.
Press the button “Start Analyzing” to begin exosome isolation.
Collect the exosome solution from the EXODUS device using a pipette.
Reconstitute the collected exosome solution to 300 µL in a 1.5 mL centrifugation tube with 1X PBS.
Collect human tears with Schirmer's test paper (30 mm).
Dissolve the Schirmer's test paper into 5 mL PBS and incubate on a shaker at 4 °C for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge at 200 x g, 4 °C for 10 min.
Centrifuge at 3,000 x g, 4 °C for 10 min.
Transfer supernatants to a new tube (4.5 mL).
Filter supernatant with a 0.22 µm syringe filter.
Collect filtration in a 15 mL tube.
Start the EXODUS system.
Load the prepared sample tube in the sample holder.
Set the isolation parameters: Negative pressure -20 kPa, Conversion time 20 s, Sample wash times 2.
Press the button “Out” to load the EXODUS device.
Press the button “Start Analyzing” to start exosome isolation.
Collect the exosome solution from the EXODUS device using a pipette.
Reconstitute the exosome solution to 300 µL in a 1.5 mL centrifugation tube with 1X PBS.
